message: Hello, my son Oscar is 8 years old and wants to try BJJ. How do we start?

Hi! That's awesome that Oscar wants to try Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu! I'm Emma from Gracie Farmington Valley. The best way to start is with a free trial class so he can see if he loves it. No experience needed and there's no commitment. Would you like to get him signed up for a trial?
Yes, we’d love to sign up for a trial class! What time slots do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial class details to?
You can send the details to tester.maple@gmail.com.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Now I just need Oscar's full name and date of birth to get him registered for the trial.
Oscar Maple, and his birthday is April 12, 2018.

Perfect! Oscar is 8, so he'll be in our Kids 8-13 Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class. I have a couple spots available this week:

Tuesday, July 7th at 5:30 PM
Thursday, July 9th at 5:30 PM

Which works better for you?
Let’s go with Tuesday, July 7th at 5:30 PM.

Awesome! Oscar is all set for Tuesday, July 7th at 5:30 PM for his free trial class. You'll get a confirmation email at tester.maple@gmail.com with all the details. Just have him wear comfortable workout clothes. We're at 15 Cheryl Dr d in Canton. See you then!
